variants.title: Hall and van der Pauw: a doped ZnO thin film
variants.sample: Al-doped ZnO film, 200 nm, degenerate n-type (SIMULATED)
variants.method: Hall bar and van der Pauw, 20 to 400 K
variants.unknown: sheet density, mobility against T, scattering mechanism
variants.note: A degenerate oxide: the density does not change with T and grain-boundary / impurity scattering keeps the mobility low (tens of cm^2/V s). The mobility terms are illustrative.

source.title: Schroder, Semiconductor Material and Device Characterization, ch. 8
source.note: the film's mobility terms are illustrative

variants.title: Hall and van der Pauw: a monolayer MoS2 flake
variants.sample: Monolayer MoS2 flake on SiO2, n about 1e17 per m^2 (SIMULATED)
variants.method: Hall bar and van der Pauw, 20 to 400 K
variants.unknown: sheet density, mobility against T, phonon exponent
variants.note: A two-dimensional channel: tens of cm^2/V s at room temperature, phonon-limited with an exponent near 1.7 above about 100 K. Values illustrative, of the order reported for monolayer MoS2 - verify.

source.title: B. Radisavljevic and A. Kis, Nature Materials 12, 815 (2013)
